name: JERA Hekinan Thermal Power Station Unit 4 ammonia co-firing demonstration, Aichi, Japan (with IHI)
description: 1 GW coal unit; world's first large-scale demonstration of 20% (by heating value) fuel-ammonia substitution; three-month trial concluded June 2024 with positive results

sources.note: Hydrocarbon Processing, 27 Jun 2024 (trial concluded, positive results); Argus Media (20% co-firing at the 1 GW No.4 unit); IHI/SwRI Apr 2022: NOx at 20% co-firing same as coal firing, NH3 and N2O in exhaust under detection limit; read 2026-10-28
